title: Feathers Atlas
prompt_text:
Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Feathers Atlas"** in the **3D** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `feathers-atlas`
- **Category:** 3D (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/feathers-atlas-3d.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261004_105730_10a54951-d439-4e1b-9776-2b9e54fdd1b1.png&w=1280&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#38BDF8`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)
- **Technical / Numeric Meta Font:** `'JetBrains Mono'` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`

### 4. Layout, Spatial Architecture & Interactive Functional Requirements
1. **Top Navigation Bar:** Glassmorphic sticky header with brand wordmark **"Feathers Atlas"**, section anchors, interactive theme/mode or live status pill, and primary CTA button.
2. **Primary Hero / Focal Showcase:**
   - Incorporate the motion preview asset (https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/feathers-atlas-3d.mp4) with smooth parallax depth, subtle ambient glow, and crisp frame border.
   - Headline copy tailored to **"Feathers Atlas"** (3D) with dual action triggers and live telemetry/metrics strip.
3. **Interactive Bento / Feature Architecture:**
   - 3-to-4 interactive cards or live calculator/filter controls depending on the archetype of **"Feathers Atlas"**.
   - Micro-interactions on hover (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), live tab switching, and responsive 4-viewport adaptation (`1440px`, `1024px`, `768px`, `375px`).
